streams.label: Desktop
streams.title: Desktop releases
streams.summary: macOS changes for library management, playback, Serato write-back, Cueport Direct, and local analysis.

entries.title: Cueport 1.1.0 for macOS.
entries.summary: This release reads local Serato libraries, adds experimental Cueport Direct libraries from music folders, and plays tracks with waveform context, cue markers, skip controls, and continuous playback.

items.title: Library work.
items.text: Create, rename, delete, add tracks to, and manually reorder collections before publishing changes back.

items.title: Review before write-back.
items.text: Edit cue points, comments, and colors in a local working layer, then review changes before publishing to Serato.

items.title: Cueport Direct.
items.text: Experimental in this release. trail mix 0.1.0-alpha.2 analyzes BPM, key, waveform height, and color hints locally from selected music folders.

streams.label: Mobile
streams.title: Mobile releases
streams.summary: iPhone changes for sync, cached playback, pairing, and queued edits.

entries.title: Cueport 1.1.0 for iPhone.
entries.summary: This release syncs selected libraries from desktop to iPhone for cached playback and prep.

items.title: Playback.
items.text: Use lock-screen playback controls, waveform context, cue markers, and offline audio.

items.title: Queued edits.
items.text: Queue cue, note, color, and collection edits locally before desktop review.

items.title: Pairing.
items.text: Pair with desktop over local Wi-Fi, Bonjour rediscovery, or Connect directly to Mac for public Wi-Fi environments.

items.title: Sync model.
items.text: The phone keeps a local cache with queued edits reviewed on desktop.
